newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN no comment on call for head to quit.
newsitem.headline: GAN no comment on call for head to quit.

text.p: State insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) and its banking unit CIC both said on Monday they had no comment to make when contacted about the French government's call for GAN chairman Jean-Jacques Bonnaud to quit.
A finance ministry spokesman said shortly after midday that the government had called for Bonnaud's resignation.

The call follows the government decision last week to scrap a tender for the privatisation of CIC and comments by Finance Minister Jean Arthuis the same day that Bannaud and CIC chairman Bernard Yoncourt had not helped promote the sell-off.
Whoever is GAN chairman formally decides who heads CIC.
